#1
भूय|bhūyaḥ|bhūyas — again, further, once more (bhūyaḥ: adverb; visarga dropped before the vowel e- of eva, -aḥ + e- → -a e-, the rule for any visarga before a non-a vowel)
एव|eva|eva — indeed, just
महाबाहो|mahā-bāho|mahā — great (first compound member);;bāhu — arm (mahā-bāhu: 'great-armed', an epithet of Arjuna, vocative sg.)
शृणु|śṛṇu|śru — to hear, listen (śṛṇu: imperative 2nd sg. 'listen!')
मे|me|aham — I (me: gen. sg. enclitic 'my', governing vacaḥ)
परमं|paramam|parama — supreme, highest (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with vacaḥ)
वचः|vacaḥ|vacas — word, speech (acc. sg. neut., object of śṛṇu)
--
यत्तेऽहं|yat te aham|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring back to vacaḥ of pāda a, object of vakṣyāmi; -t + t- → -tt-, assimilation);;tvam — you (te: dat. sg. enclitic 'to you', governed with prīyamāṇāya);;aham — I (nom. sg., subject of vakṣyāmi; te + aham: -e + a- → -e with avagraha)
प्रीयमाणाय|prīyamāṇāya|prī — to please, delight (prīyamāṇa: passive present participle 'being pleased, being dear', dat. sg. masc., agreeing with te)
वक्ष्यामि|vakṣyāmi|vac — to speak, declare (vakṣyāmi: future 1st sg. 'I shall declare')
हितकाम्यया|hita-kāmyayā|hita — benefit, welfare (first compound member);;kāmyā — desire, wish (hita-kāmyā: 'a wish for [your] welfare', instr. sg. fem., adverbial 'out of a desire for your benefit')
#2
न|na|na — not
मे|me|aham — I (me: gen. sg. enclitic 'my', governing prabhavam)
विदुः|viduḥ|vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they know')
सुरगणाः|sura-gaṇāḥ|sura — god, deity (first compound member);;gaṇa — host, multitude (sura-gaṇa: 'the hosts of gods', nom. pl. masc., subject)
प्रभवं|prabhavam|pra-bhava — origin, source, coming-into-being (acc. sg. masc., object of viduḥ)
न|na|na — not
महर्षयः|mahā-ṛṣayaḥ|mahā — great (first compound member);;ṛṣi — sage, seer (mahā-ṛṣi: 'great sage', nom. pl. masc., subject, understood with viduḥ prabhavam repeated; ā + ṛ → ar)
--
अहमादिर्हि|aham ādiḥ hi|aham — I (nom. sg., subject; joined before ā-, no change);;ādi — beginning, origin (ādiḥ: nom. sg. masc., predicate);;hi — for, indeed (particle; ādiḥ + hi: -iḥ + h- → -ir h-)
देवानां|devānām|deva — god, deity (gen. pl., 'of the gods')
महर्षीणां|mahā-ṛṣīṇām|mahā — great (first compound member);;ṛṣi — sage (mahā-ṛṣi: gen. pl., 'of the great sages'; ā + ṛ → ar)
च|ca|ca — and
सर्वशः|sarvaśaḥ|sarvaśas — wholly, in every respect, altogether (adverb)
#3
यो|yaḥ|yad — who, which (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative pronoun, subject of vetti; -aḥ before m- → -o)
मामजमनादिं|mām ajam anādim|aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of vetti; joined before a-, no change);;a-ja — unborn (ajam: acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām; joined before a-, no change);;an-ādi — without beginning, beginningless (anādim: acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām)
च|ca|ca — and
वेत्ति|vetti|vid — to know (vetti: present 3rd sg. 'knows')
लोकमहेश्वरम्|loka-mahā-īśvaram|loka — world (first compound member);;mahā — great (second member);;īśvara — lord (loka-mahā-īśvara: 'the great lord of the world', acc. sg. masc., in apposition to mām; ā + ī → e)
--
असंमूढः|a-saṃmūḍhaḥ|a-sam-muh — to be deluded, confused (saṃmūḍha: past participle negated by a-, 'undeluded', nom. sg. masc., subject)
स|saḥ|tad — he, that one (nom. sg. masc., resumptive subject; the pronoun sa/eṣa loses its visarga to sa before any following consonant, an exception to the ordinary -aḥ sandhi rules seen elsewhere in this chapter)
मर्त्येषु|martyeṣu|martya — mortal (loc. pl., 'among mortals')
सर्वपापैः|sarva-pāpaiḥ|sarva — all (first compound member);;pāpa — sin, evil (sarva-pāpa: 'all sins', instr. pl., 'from all sins')
प्रमुच्यते|pramucyate|pra-muc — to release, free (pramucyate: passive present 3rd sg. 'is released')
#4
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः|buddhiḥ jñānam a-saṃmohaḥ|buddhi — intellect, understanding, the faculty of discernment (nom. sg. fem., subject, understood with the verb bhavanti of verse 5; -iḥ + j- → -ir j-);;jñāna — knowledge (nom. sg. neut., subject; joined before a-, no change);;a-saṃmoha — freedom from delusion, non-confusion (from sam-muh; nom. sg. masc., subject)
क्षमा|kṣamā|kṣamā — patience, forbearance (nom. sg. fem., subject)
सत्यं|satyam|satya — truth, truthfulness (nom. sg. neut., subject)
दमः|damaḥ|dama — self-restraint, control of the senses (nom. sg. masc., subject)
शमः|śamaḥ|śama — tranquility, calmness of mind (nom. sg. masc., subject)
--
सुखं|sukham|sukha — happiness, pleasure (nom. sg. neut., subject)
दुःखं|duḥkham|duḥkha — pain, suffering (nom. sg. neut., subject)
भवोऽभावो|bhavaḥ abhāvaḥ|bhava — coming-into-being, existence (nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;a-bhāva — non-existence, ceasing-to-be (nom. sg. masc., subject; its own -aḥ before the voiced bh- of bhayam → -o)
भयं|bhayam|bhaya — fear (nom. sg. neut., subject)
चाभयमेव|ca abhayam eva|ca — and (ca + abhayam: a + a → ā);;a-bhaya — fearlessness (nom. sg. neut., subject; joined before e-, no change)
च|ca|ca — and;;eva — indeed, too (eva belongs with the preceding cābhayam; this final ca is the correlative closing 'both fear and fearlessness')
#5
अहिंसा|ahiṃsā|a-hiṃsā — non-violence, non-injury (nom. sg. fem., subject)
समता|samatā|sama-tā — sameness, equanimity (nom. sg. fem., subject)
तुष्टिस्तपो|tuṣṭiḥ tapaḥ|tuṣṭi — contentment, satisfaction (nom. sg. fem., subject; -iḥ + t- → -is t-, visarga before a voiceless consonant);;tapas — austerity, ascetic heat (nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ before d- → -o)
दानं|dānam|dāna — giving, generosity, gift (nom. sg. neut., subject)
यशोऽयशः|yaśaḥ ayaśaḥ|yaśas — fame, glory (nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;a-yaśas — ill fame, infamy (nom. sg. neut., subject)
--
भवन्ति|bhavanti|bhū — to be, come to be, arise (present 3rd pl. 'they arise'; the predicate completing the list of subjects begun in verse 4)
भावा|bhāvāḥ|bhāva — state, disposition, quality (nom. pl. masc., subject, summing up the list of verses 4-5a; visarga dropped before the voiced bh- of bhūtānām, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
भूतानां|bhūtānām|bhūta — being (gen. pl., 'of beings')
मत्त|mattaḥ|mad — me (mattaḥ: ablative sg. 'from me', formed with the ablative suffix -tas; visarga dropped before the vowel e- of eva)
एव|eva|eva — alone, indeed ('from me alone')
पृथग्विधाः|pṛthag-vidhāḥ|pṛthak — separately, variously (first compound member; -k + v- → -g v-, voicing);;vidha — kind, sort (pṛthag-vidha: 'of various/manifold kinds', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with bhāvāḥ)
#6
महर्षयः|mahā-ṛṣayaḥ|mahā — great (first compound member);;ṛṣi — sage, seer (mahā-ṛṣi: 'great sage', nom. pl. masc., subject; ā + ṛ → ar)
सप्त|sapta|sapta — seven (numeral, nom. pl., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ)
पूर्वे|pūrve|pūrva — former, prior, ancient (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ, 'of old')
चत्वारो|catvāraḥ|catur — four (catvāraḥ: numeral, nom. pl. masc., agreeing with manavaḥ; -aḥ before m- → -o)
मनवस्तथा|manavaḥ tathā|Manu — Manu, the primal ancestor and lawgiver of mankind (Hindu cosmology names several; the 'four' here are the Manus of the current and preceding aeons; manavaḥ: nom. pl., subject);;tathā — likewise, so too (manavaḥ + tathā: -aḥ + t- → -as t-)
--
मद्भावा|mad-bhāvāḥ|mad — me (stem form, first compound member);;bhāva — nature, state of being (mad-bhāva: 'of my nature, sprung from me', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with maharṣayaḥ and manavaḥ; visarga dropped before the voiced m- of mānasāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
मानसा|mānasāḥ|mānasa — mind-born, mental, of the mind (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with the same subjects; visarga dropped before the voiced j- of jātāḥ)
जाता|jātāḥ|jan — to be born (jāta: past participle 'born', nom. pl. masc.; visarga dropped before the voiced y- of yeṣām)
येषां|yeṣām|yad — who, which (yeṣām: gen. pl. relative, 'of whom', referring to the sages and Manus)
लोक|lokaḥ|loka — the world (nom. sg. masc., in loose apposition with prajāḥ, 'these creatures of the world'; -aḥ + i- → -a i-, visarga simply dropping before a vowel other than a-)
इमाः|imāḥ|idam — this (imāḥ: nom. pl. fem., agreeing with prajāḥ)
प्रजाः|prajāḥ|prajā — offspring, creature, progeny (nom. pl. fem., subject/predicate)
#7
एतां|etām|etad — this (acc. sg. fem., agreeing with vibhūtim)
विभूतिं|vibhūtim|vi-bhūti — manifestation, extraordinary power, glory (acc. sg. fem., object of vetti)
योगं|yogam|yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (acc. sg. masc., second object of vetti)
च|ca|ca — and
मम|mama|aham — I (mama: gen. sg. 'my', modifying vibhūtim and yogam)
यो|yaḥ|yad — who, which (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative, subject of vetti; -aḥ before v- → -o)
वेत्ति|vetti|vid — to know (vetti: present 3rd sg. 'knows')
तत्त्वतः|tattvataḥ|tattva — true nature, reality, essence (tattvataḥ: adverb 'truly, in reality', formed with the ablative adverbial suffix -tas)
--
सोऽविकम्पेन|saḥ avikampena|tad — he (saḥ: nom. sg. masc., subject; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha);;a-vikampa — unwavering, untrembling (avikampena: instr. sg., agreeing with yogena)
योगेन|yogena|yoga — yoga, kept untranslated (instr. sg., 'with [unwavering] yoga')
युज्यते|yujyate|yuj — to yoke, join, unite (yujyate: passive present 3rd sg. 'is united')
नात्र|na atra|na — not (na + atra: a + a → ā);;atra — here, in this matter
संशयः|saṃśayaḥ|saṃśaya — doubt (nom. sg. masc., subject)
#8
अहं|aham|aham — I (nom. sg., subject)
सर्वस्य|sarvasya|sarva — all, everything (gen. sg., 'of everything')

मत्तः|mattaḥ|mad — me (mattaḥ: ablative sg. 'from me')
सर्वं|sarvam|sarva — all, everything (nom. sg. neut., subject)
प्रवर्तते|pravartate|pra-vṛt — to proceed, come forth, evolve (pravartate: present middle 3rd sg.)
--
इति|iti|iti — thus (closing the preceding statement)
मत्वा|matvā|man — to think, consider (matvā: gerund 'having considered, understanding [this]')
भजन्ते|bhajante|bhaj — to worship, revere, share in (bhajante: present middle 3rd pl. 'they worship')
मां|mām|aham — I (acc. sg. 'me', object of bhajante)
बुधा|budhāḥ|budha — wise, learned (nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced bh- of bhāvasamanvitāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
भावसमन्विताः|bhāva-samanvitāḥ|bhāva — feeling, disposition, state of mind (first compound member);;sam-anvita — endowed with, possessed of, imbued with (bhāva-samanvita: 'endowed with [right] feeling', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with budhāḥ)
#9
मच्चित्ता|mac-cittāḥ|mad — me (stem form, first compound member; mat + citta: -t + c- → -c c-, assimilation);;citta — mind, thought (mac-citta: 'whose thoughts are on me', nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced m- of madgataprāṇāḥ, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
मद्गतप्राणा|mad-gata-prāṇāḥ|mad — me (stem form, first compound member; mat + gata: -t + g- → -d g-, voicing);;gata — gone to, directed towards (second member);;prāṇa — life-breath, vital energy (mad-gata-prāṇa: 'whose vital energies are absorbed in me', nom. pl. masc., subject, in apposition to maccittāḥ; visarga dropped before the voiced b- of bodhayantaḥ)
बोधयन्तः|bodhayantaḥ|budh — to awaken, understand (causative bodhayanti, 'to enlighten, instruct'; bodhayant: present participle, nom. pl. masc., 'instructing, enlightening [one another]')
परस्परम्|parasparam|paras-para — each other, one another (parasparam: acc. sg., used adverbially, 'mutually')
--
कथयन्तश्च|kathayantaḥ ca|kath — to tell, relate, speak of (causative kathayati; kathayant: present participle, nom. pl. masc., 'speaking of [me]'; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-);;ca — and
मां|mām|aham — I (acc. sg. 'me', object of bodhayantaḥ and kathayantaḥ)
नित्यं|nityam|nityam — always, constantly (adverb)
तुष्यन्ति|tuṣyanti|tuṣ — to be content, satisfied (present 3rd pl.)
च|ca|ca — and
रमन्ति|ramanti|ram — to delight, rejoice, take pleasure (present 3rd pl.)
च|ca|ca — and
#10
तेषां|teṣām|tad — they, those (teṣām: gen. pl., 'of them', referring to the devotees of verse 9)
सततयुक्तानां|satata-yuktānām|satata — constant, continual (first compound member);;yukta — joined, disciplined, engaged (satata-yukta: 'constantly disciplined', gen. pl., agreeing with teṣām)
भजतां|bhajatām|bhaj — to worship, revere (bhajat: present participle 'worshiping', gen. pl., agreeing with teṣām)
प्रीतिपूर्वकम्|prīti-pūrvakam|prīti — love, affection (first compound member);;pūrvaka — preceded by, accompanied by (prīti-pūrvakam: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'lovingly, with affection')
--
ददामि|dadāmi|dā — to give (dadāmi: present 1st sg. 'I give')

तं|tam|tad — that (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with buddhiyogam)
येन|yena|yad — which (yena: instr. sg., 'by which')
मामुपयान्ति|mām upayānti|aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of upayānti; joined before u-, no change);;upa-yā — to approach, come to (upayānti: present 3rd pl. 'they come to, attain')
ते|te|tad — they (nom. pl., resuming teṣām of pāda a)
#11
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं|teṣām eva anukampā-artham aham ajñāna-jam|tad — they (teṣām: gen. sg., 'for them', referring to the devotees of verses 9-10; joined before e-, no change);;eva — indeed, alone (eva + anukampā: a + a → ā);;anukampā — compassion, sympathy (first compound member);;artha — purpose, sake (anukampā-artham: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'for the sake of compassion', 'out of compassion'; joined before a-, no change);;aham — I (nom. sg., subject of nāśayāmi; joined before a-, no change);;a-jñāna — ignorance, absence of knowledge (first compound member);;ja — born, arising from (ajñāna-ja: 'born of ignorance', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with tamaḥ)
तमः|tamaḥ|tamas — darkness (acc. sg. neut., object of nāśayāmi in the next line)
--
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो|nāśayāmi ātma-bhāva-sthaḥ|naś — to be destroyed, perish (causative nāśayati, 'to destroy'; nāśayāmi: present 1st sg. 'I destroy'; -i + ā- → -y ā-);;ātman — self, soul (first compound member);;bhāva — being, inner state (second member);;stha — situated, abiding (ātma-bhāva-stha: 'abiding in [their] inmost being', nom. sg. masc., agreeing with the subject aham; -aḥ before j- → -o)
ज्ञानदीपेन|jñāna-dīpena|jñāna — knowledge (first compound member);;dīpa — lamp, light (jñāna-dīpa: 'the lamp of knowledge', instr. sg., instrumental means of destroying tamaḥ)
भास्वता|bhāsvatā|bhāsvat — shining, radiant, brilliant (instr. sg., agreeing with jñānadīpena)
#12
परं|param|para — higher, supreme (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with brahma)
ब्रह्म|brahma|brahman — brahman, kept untranslated (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
परं|param|para — higher, supreme (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with dhāma)
धाम|dhāma|dhāman — abode, dwelling-place, radiance (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
पवित्रं|pavitram|pavitra — pure, purifying (nom. sg. neut., predicate to bhavān)
परमं|paramam|parama — supreme, highest (nom. sg. neut., agreeing with pavitram, '[the] supreme [purifier]')
भवान्|bhavān|bhavat — you, your reverence (bhavān: honorific 2nd person pronoun, nom. sg. masc., subject)
--
पुरुषं|puruṣam|puruṣa — person, spirit (acc. sg. masc.; this line's epithets continue as object complements of āhuḥ tvām, 'they call you', in the next verse)
शाश्वतं|śāśvatam|śāśvata — eternal, everlasting, perpetual (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
दिव्यमादिदेवमजं|divyam ādi-devam ajam|divya — divine, heavenly (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam; joined before ā-, no change);;ādi — first, primal (first compound member);;deva — god (ādi-deva: 'the primal god', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam; joined before a-, no change);;a-ja — unborn (ajam: acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
विभुम्|vibhum|vibhu — all-pervading, mighty, powerful (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with puruṣam)
#13
आहुस्त्वामृषयः|āhuḥ tvām ṛṣayaḥ|ah — to say, declare, call (āhuḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they call'; -uḥ + t- → -us t-);;tvam — you (tvām: acc. sg., object of āhuḥ, continuing the epithets of verse 12 line b);;ṛṣi — sage, seer (ṛṣayaḥ: nom. pl., subject of āhuḥ; joined before ṛ-, no change)
सर्वे|sarve|sarva — all (nom. pl. masc., agreeing with ṛṣayaḥ)
देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा|devarṣiḥ Nāradaḥ tathā|deva — god, divine (first compound member);;ṛṣi — sage (deva-ṛṣi: 'divine sage', a class of celestial seer, nom. sg. masc.; a + ṛ → ar);;Nārada — the sage Nārada, a celestial seer and messenger among the gods, traditionally a son of Brahmā (nom. sg., in apposition to devarṣiḥ; -iḥ + n- → -ir n-);;tathā — likewise, also (Nāradaḥ + tathā: -aḥ + t- → -as t-)
--
असितो|Asitaḥ|Asita — the sage Asita, a seer associated with Devala (nom. sg.; -aḥ before d- → -o)
देवलो|Devalaḥ|Devala — the sage Devala, often paired with Asita in tradition (nom. sg.; -aḥ before v- → -o)
व्यासः|Vyāsaḥ|Vyāsa — the sage Vyāsa, compiler of the Vedas and the Mahābhārata, traditionally the poem's own narrator's source (nom. sg.)
स्वयं|svayam|svayam — oneself, in person (adverb/pronoun, here agreeing with the understood 'you')
चैव|ca eva|ca — and (ca + eva: a + e → ai);;eva — indeed, also
ब्रवीषि|bravīṣi|brū — to say, speak, declare (bravīṣi: present 2nd sg. 'you say')
मे|me|aham — I (me: dat. sg. enclitic 'to me')
#14
सर्वमेतदृतं|sarvam etat ṛtam|sarva — all, entirely (sarvam: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, 'wholly'; joined before e-, no change);;etad — this (etat: acc. sg. neut., agreeing with ṛtam; -t + ṛ- → -d ṛ-, voicing before a vowel);;ṛta — true, truth (acc. sg. neut., object of manye)
मन्ये|manye|man — to think, believe, consider (manye: present middle 1st sg. 'I believe')
यन्मां|yat mām|yad — which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring to etad ṛtam, object of vadasi; -t + m- → -n m-, assimilation);;aham — I (mām: acc. sg. 'me', object of vadasi)
वदसि|vadasi|vad — to speak, say, tell (vadasi: present 2nd sg. 'you tell')
केशव|keśava|Keśava — 'having fine hair' or 'slayer of the demon Keśin', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative)
--
न|na|na — not
हि|hi|hi — for, indeed (particle)
ते|te|tvam — you (te: gen. sg. enclitic 'your', governing vyaktim)
भगवन्व्यक्तिं|bhagavan vyaktim|bhagavat — the Blessed One, the Lord (bhagavan: vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa; joined before v-, no change);;vi-akta — manifestation, self-revelation, true nature (vyaktim: acc. sg. fem., object of viduḥ)
विदुर्देवा|viduḥ devāḥ|vid — to know (viduḥ: perfect 3rd pl. 'they know'; -uḥ + d- → -ur d-);;deva — god, deity (devāḥ: nom. pl. masc., subject; visarga dropped before the voiced n- of na, the ending here being -āḥ, not -aḥ)
न|na|na — not, nor
